Dive into color and pattern in this vibrant Tie & Dye Workshop. Learn how to transform plain fabric into eye-catching designs using classic resist-dyeing techniques. Explore different tying methods, folding styles, and color combinations to create unique patterns like spirals, stripes, and abstract blends. Guided step-by-step by a professional artist, this workshop is fun, hands-on, and beginner-friendly.

All materials are included, just come ready to experiment with colors, get a little messy, and take home your own custom tie-dyed creation.

Perfect for beginners, DIY enthusiasts, and anyone looking for a playful and creative experience.

Discover the magic of color in this immersive Watercolor Blending Workshop. Learn how to seamlessly blend colors to create soft gradients, smooth transitions, and expressive effects using watercolor techniques. Explore methods like wet-on-wet, layering, and color mixing to bring depth and harmony to your artwork. Guided step-by-step by a professional artist, this workshop is soothing, experimental, and perfect for beginners.

All materials are included, just come ready to play with colors, explore fluid techniques, and create your own beautifully blended compositions.

Perfect for beginners, art lovers, and anyone looking to unwind through a calming and creative painting experience.

Experience focus and creativity in this calming Guided Mandala Drawing Workshop. Learn how to create intricate mandala patterns using structured, step-by-step techniques that build symmetry, balance, and flow. Explore elements like repetitive patterns, line work, and detailing while developing patience and mindfulness through the process. Guided by a professional artist, this workshop is designed to be relaxing, meditative, and beginner-friendly.

All materials are included, just come ready to slow down, draw, and immerse yourself in the rhythm of patterns. Take home your own beautifully detailed mandala artwork along with a sense of calm and accomplishment.

Perfect for beginners, art enthusiasts, and anyone looking for a mindful and therapeutic creative experience.

Explore the power of simplicity in this engaging Minimalist Line Art Workshop with Sketch Pens. Learn how to create striking, detailed illustrations using clean line work and just two colors of sketch pens. This workshop focuses on composition, balance, contrast, and storytelling through minimal elements—helping you turn simple lines into expressive, visually appealing artwork. Guided step-by-step by a professional artist, the process is intuitive, creative, and beginner-friendly.

All materials are included, just bring your creativity and an eye for detail. Walk away with your own bold, minimal artwork created using a limited color palette.

Perfect for beginners, design enthusiasts, and anyone looking to explore modern, minimal art styles.

Capture the serenity of nature in this immersive Watercolor Landscape Workshop. Learn how to paint beautiful landscapes using fluid watercolor techniques that bring depth, light, and atmosphere to your work. Explore essentials like color blending, washes, layering, and creating textures for skies, mountains, trees, and water bodies. Guided step-by-step by a professional artist, this workshop is designed to be calming, expressive, and beginner-friendly.

All materials are included, just come ready to explore, paint, and express your creativity through soft, flowing landscapes. Perfect for beginners, art lovers, and anyone looking for a peaceful and inspiring creative experience.

Discover the beauty of nature through texture and printmaking in our Biophiliic Print Workshop. Learn how to transform simple leaves into stunning textured artworks using creative layering and printing techniques. This hands-on session is guided step-by-step by a professional artist and is perfect for beginners as well as art enthusiasts.

All materials are included, just bring your curiosity and creativity. Walk away with your own textured leaf artwork and a calming, nature-inspired experience.

Explore the beauty of textures and florals in this hands-on Texture Flowers Print Workshop. Learn how to create stunning flower prints using textured techniques that add depth, movement, and character to your artwork. Guided step-by-step by a professional artist, this workshop is beginner-friendly and deeply relaxing.



All materials are included, just come ready to experiment, create, and take home your own textured floral artwork.



Perfect for beginners, and anyone looking for a creative break

featured_reviews.name: Trupti Kadam
featured_reviews.review_text:
We celebrated our birthday in the most creative and memorable way this year—with a pottery workshop! It was such a unique and wholesome experience, surrounded by friends, clay, and lots of laughter.

From the moment we arrived, the space felt welcoming and calming. The instructors were patient, encouraging, and made sure even the beginners felt confident while working on the wheel or hand-building pieces. We got to explore our creativity, get our hands dirty, and make something special with our own hands—a refreshing break from the usual birthday routines.

What made it even more special was how personal and peaceful the experience felt. Time flew by as we shaped, smoothed, and experimented with different forms. Everyone left with their own little masterpiece and a big smile.

Highly recommend this for anyone looking for a meaningful, hands-on activity to celebrate any occasion—or even just to try something new!

featured_reviews.review_text: Manju Panchal is a very talented artist. I recently got a set of three acrylic paintings of Engelberg, Switzerland, done by her, and they turned out amazing.
